_doc: Rocket tiers (Mk I-IV): Lumi's ship, automation/ship_model.gd ([ship]; each Mk adds parts, ShipTiers.parts_for), bought in the workbench Rockets tab. Mk I comes with a level 5 base. countdown_s/sequence: shorter launch cinematic; flight_s: globe flight; recharge_s: energy cells refill after a launch before the next one (M3-22: 30 s at Mk I, so a hop never means waiting); cargo_mult/cargo_period_s: Rocket Cargo pods (automation/cargo.gd); warp: instant hop (no countdown, a flash). work_charge (automation/rocket_charge.gd): while Lumi works in the city where the rocket stands (her own cleaning, pressing a bale, planting or watering), the cells charge faster: each piece of work keeps her 'working' for window_s seconds, during which the cells gain extra_rate seconds of charge per second on top of the clock; a pressed bale adds per_bale_s at once. ready_toast: say so when the cells fill after a hop.

tiers.name: Mk I Cradle
tiers.desc: A compact one-seat glider: pearl hull, swept wings, twin engines and lift fans for vertical take-off.

tiers.name: Mk II Glide
tiers.desc: Wing extensions steady the climb: shorter countdown, faster flight, cells refill twice as fast. Cargo pods carry 50% more.

tiers.name: Mk III Halo
tiers.desc: Bigger engines and a new canopy. Cells refill in seconds; cargo pods carry 2.5x, more often.

tiers.name: Mk IV Aurora Warp
tiers.desc: Landing gear, cargo pods and a warp core: instant hops with no recharge. Cargo pods carry 4x, every 30 s.
